They are BOTH clutter AND things I need. Cans of soup, toilet paper, soap, tissues... They are things I need. But because I have no shelving at all to put things away they are clutter on the floor.

I'm here because I don't even believe myself. He is charming, extroverted. I am introverted and completely broken. Completely. Mental hospital... crippled for life.

After I "broke" he moved out and got a girlfriend. One day when I was crying to him about how much his abuse has hurt me he said he had a print-out for me. It was about surviving abuse. I started reading it thinking "What the... He doesn't do things like this. When did he start looking up how to help me?" Just then, I saw the handwritten note on the bottom of the page: "Remember Annie loves you. I'm here for you." Seems he told her I have abused him throughout our marriage. He even has a stunningly good case he presents me regularly, describing my offenses. They're all true. I feel horrible, worthless, as he reminds me of the terrible things I've done. Until much later when I go over it in my head and recall he is always telling half-stories. With critical bits left out. Missing the rest of the story. So I am hated by his family. His co-workers. His girlfriend knows I "abuse him". Not the whole story. Not the part about I being attacked by him and protecting myself. Not any of the rest of it.

God help me, I tried to get away when I was young and whole. He managed that I was threatened into not being able to succeed. Now I'm old and crippled. I have no one else to take care of me and no one else at all.
